name: BOE Technology Group Company Limited
summary: BOE Technology Group Company Limited, established in Beijing, China in 1993, operates as a global Internet of Things (IoT) company. It is dedicated to delivering advanced intelligent interface products and expert services that facilitate information interaction and promote human well-being across the world. The company's operations are organized into several strategic business units. Its Display Business focuses on cutting-edge screen technologies, including TFT-LCD, AMOLED Oxide, and Microdisplay. These technologies are integrated into an extensive array of devices such as smartphones, tablets, laptops, computer monitors, televisions, in-vehicle displays, electronic shelf labels, tiled display screens, industrial control systems, wearables, VR/AR devices, electronic tags, home appliances, healthcare equipment, mobile payment solutions, and interactive whiteboards. This segment also offers various smart terminal products, such as low-power and 3D displays, alongside comprehensive design and manufacturing services for system solutions. Through its IoT Innovation Business, BOE provides integrated hardware and software solutions tailored for smart finance, intelligent parks, government affairs, transportation, and energy sectors. It also offers urban light space services and large-scale product solutions. The Sensor and Application Solutions segment is committed to the design and production of sophisticated sensor devices and system solutions. These cater to diverse applications in medical biological detection, transportation, construction, consumer electronics, microwave communications, and industrial sensing, featuring products like flat panel X-ray detectors, digital microfluidic chips, PDLC glass, fingerprint identification systems, and industrial sensors. Additionally, BOE is a prominent provider of Mini LED backlight and display products. Its Smart Medicine & Engineering division delivers a full spectrum of healthcare services, encompassing digital hospital management, health management powered by an IoT platform, and a complete continuum of care from prevention, treatment, and therapy to nursing, complemented by associated technology services.
